data.one_liner: Applies a gyroscope or hover-based motion effect to Flutter widgets.
data.what_it_does: The package provides a Motion widget that applies a gyroscope-based tilt effect to its child on mobile platforms, and a hover-based effect on web or desktop. It supports customizable elevation, shadow, and glare effects with damping options.
use_when: You want to add 3D-like gyroscope tilt effects to cards or UI components.
You want pointer-based hover motion effects for web or desktop targets.
avoid_when: You are targeting environments where device motion sensors or pointer events are not suitable.
You need standard physics-based animations or layout transitions.
strengths: Supports both gyroscope and hover events seamlessly.
Provides customizable configurations for shadows, elevation, glare, and damping.
weaknesses: Requires explicit initialization before running the Flutter app.
Safari iOS has specific permission and gradient rendering limitations.
data.setup_notes: Initialize the plugin at Dart runtime using Motion.instance.initialize() before running the app.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a general-purpose animation library for timeline and effect sequencing rather than sensor-driven motion.
